design.title: Design Guide
design.content:
# Design Guide

## Typography
- Font Family: Inter
- Headings: 700 weight, -0.025em tracking

## Colors
- Accent: #2563eb (Blue 600)
- Text: #111827 (Gray 900)

## Spacing
- Unit: 4px
- Scale: 4, 8, 12, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64

architecture.title: Architecture Guide
architecture.content:
# Architecture Guide

## Core Principles
- Client-server separation
- Unidirectional data flow

## Directory Structure
- `src/tools/`: Individual tool definitions
- `src/utils/`: Shared helpers

engineering.title: Engineering Guide
engineering.content:
# Engineering Guide

## Coding Standards
- Use TypeScript for all new code
- Prefer async/await over raw promises

## Workflow
- Iterate live in browser first
- Use recordToSession for all DOM/CSS/JS changes

items.name: Web Minimal Kit
items.purpose: Fast prototyping in live browser sessions
items.notes: Prefer CSS variables + small component primitives.
